gaps.explanation: p6 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints four enterprise columns (Electric, Water, Sewer, Gas) with no schedule of their own; detail[] has no business-type lines. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 99,082,175 + investment income 655,796 + grant revenue 11,003 = 99,748,974. Per column: Electric 53,857,668 + 179,429 + 115,677 + 9,710 = 54,162,484; Water 5,449,736 + 62,297 + 15,095 + 209 = 5,527,337; Sewer 6,549,403 + 600,669 + 510,097 + 382 = 7,660,551; Gas 32,380,789 + 2,184 + 14,927 + 702 = 32,398,602. Sum 99,748,974 = statement. Internal Service Fund column excluded. (Governmental revenue/expenditure gaps: different basis, explained in pass 1.)
